title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11a — maintenance relocation compatibility bridge
goal: Let the base-owned authority projection test validate exactly one legacy or relocated maintenance entry point before the internal tool is physically moved.
acceptanceCriteria: The current scripts/Generate entry point still passes the authority projection positive and drift-negative fixtures.

Both paths, neither path, and a failed maintenance invocation fail closed; no production authority or projection changes.
Protected-change and trusted-component candidate verification pass from the authorization base.
